headline: Co-founder & Barista of Bar Peteng | Certified Professional Barista | Accessibility Consultant
about: Professional Barista and Entrepreneur currently based in Leeds, UK. Co-founder of [Bar Peteng](https://instagram.com/barpeteng). A certified professional from ABCD School of Coffee (Cohort 612) with 17+ years in the music industry and expertise in digital accessibility auditing (WCAG).

items.title: ABCD School of Coffee - Cohort 612
items.desc: Certified Professional Barista. Mastery in Appreciation, Brewing, Cupping, and Definitive Espresso.

items.title: Pouring in the Dark (PITD)
items.desc: Creator of the registered IP 'Pouring in the Dark'—a unique sensory coffee experience in total darkness.

items.title: 520+ Days Visual Documentation
items.desc: Maintaining a professional daily brewing documentation streak using DJI Osmo Pocket 3.

items.title: Accessibility Consultant
items.desc: Auditing digital platforms and physical environments based on WCAG standards for CBM Global.

items.title: Professional Musician (Bassist)
items.desc: 17 years of experience. Performances include Thailand Blind Music Festival (2013-2014).
